Presently he wants to break our relationship but we have decided to perform Nikah immediately without the information & involvement of her family, because we can't live without each other. Question ------- Seeking FATWA ON PAYMENT OF MEHAR (Marriage /NIKAH ) -------------------------------------------------- 1. I was married in the year 1969. 2.The Mehar was fixed for Rs 35,000.00 (thirty five thousand only). 3.The payment terms were as below ( a ) half mehar was Mawaj-jal ( b ) half mehar was Mauj-jal. 4. I have not paid the Mehar as I was not financially sound in the early years. 5.My wife did not ask for any Meher dues and I thought that I would pay whenever my wife would demand payment of her dues. 6. However my wife till date did not demand any payment. 7. Now I wish to be relived from the burden of Mehar as per agreed mehar terms and pay the Mehar now in the year 2009. The Clarification sought is as under------------ ( a )Can I pay the total amount in one time payment .Rs 35,000.00 immediately though she has not yet asked for the Money. ( b ) Do I need to pay much more than Rs 35,000.00 as I have not paid her dues for the last 40 years. Does this need to be reviewed taking into account the inflation and fall in the value of the Rupee since last 40 years. ( c ) In case I need to pay more than Rs 35,000.00---How much more should be paid as her rightful Mehar dues ?????? COULD YOU PLEASE INSTRUCT IN LIGHT OF SHARIAT. Thanks 2662 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32928 Country: United States of America Title: My husband and I married eachother with children from a previous marriage. Since then,he has continuously pursued other women, regularly curses myself and my children and has abandoned all of my rights totally. Question: My husband and I married eachother with children from a previous marriage. Since then,he has continuously pursued other women, regularly curses myself and my children and has abandoned all of my rights totally.He isn't attracted to me and refers to me by all types of foul speech and tries to convince all of my female friends to marry him because he's a "Sheikh"to the point where they left me. His ex wife says she went through the same and she's also a very good woman.His parents also encourage him not to give me any rights because he married a divorcee and make him sleep there at night. The only thing that keeps me is we have a beautiful son, MashaAllah,whom we both love. Also I am pregnant from the few times he came home two months ago, but I'm afraid to tell him because he becomes more unjust when I'm pregnant. (I had 4 miscarriages before my 1 yr old son because of this)I am fully capable of doing this alone but what is Most pleasing to Allah? Answer ID: 32928 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1050/886/B=1432) Convince your husband with the help of any influential person, he may change his mind. Had there been an Islamic government today he would have got severe punishment due to this injustice. Keep on trying to make him understand, perhaps he will be convinced. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
